messages:
tess-cs: Seraph ops asked for a short demo window in EU+APAC, need ephemeral allowlist + regional QPS bump. Demo in ~90m, asking 30m.
seraph-pm: Demo is 14:00 UTC. CIDRs: 198.51.100.80/28 and 203.0.113.48/28. Prefer routing to eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. We'll restart clients 3m before.
tess-cs: Request: edge CIDR allow, per-region QPS x4, routing override for new conns, auto-revoke after 30m. Capture for renewal notes (they're trialing committed capacity).
sec-bot: Automated scan ok. Manual sec approval required for ephemeral whitelists.
omar-sre: I'll create CR-6722. Plan: apply allowlist on edges only, set QPS multiplier to 4 for eu & apac, add routing tag seraph-demo-6722, set TTL 35m to be safe.
lia-eng: Recommend enabling 4m prefix cache for /v1/chat to smooth spikes. I'll add it to the runbook.
seraph-pm: Restart confirmed. Cache ok.
omar-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=seraph --cidr=198.51.100.80/28 --reason="seraph-demo-6722"
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=seraph --cidr=203.0.113.48/28 --reason="seraph-demo-6722"
redwoodctl quota set --customer=seraph --region=eu-west-1 --qps-multiplier=4 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl quota set --customer=seraph --region=ap-southeast-1 --qps-multiplier=4 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl routing override --customer=seraph --preferred-regions=eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --tag=seraph-demo-6722 --expires-in=35m
redwoodctl cache set --customer=seraph --scope="/v1/chat" --type=prefix --ttl=4m --expires-in=35m
```
sec-bot: Sec approves edge CIDRs for ephemeral demo window. No control-plane exemptions.
deploy-bot: Applying CR-6722 -> starting
deploy-bot: apply: edge-allowlist/seraph -> success (198.51.100.80/28), success (203.0.113.48/28) | quotas/seraph -> success (eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) | routing/override -> success | cache/kv -> success
tess-cs: Thanks. I'll note this in the account health doc and set a renewal follow-up if demo metrics look good.
omar-sre: CR-6722 created. Auto-revoke scheduled in 35m at epoch 3523458110. Monitoring on 429/5xx enabled.
seraph-pm: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will report back after demo. :rocket:
tess-cs: Closing loop here, added follow-up to their account record.
omar-sre: Will post revoke event once the TTL expires or if we rollback early.
